source.method: read-only pg_catalog, information_schema and pg_policies inspection

anon_executable_security_definer_functio.name: public.get_admin_market_listings
anon_executable_security_definer_functio.assessment: Market listing and price metadata only. No account, identity, wallet, order, trade, reservation, balance or transaction columns are returned.

anon_executable_security_definer_functio.name: public.get_exchange_discovered_market_assets
anon_executable_security_definer_functio.assessment: Exchange discovery metadata only, limited to active recent pending/ambiguous/unmatched observations. It does not return source_payload, source_url, coingecko_id or user data.

anon_base_table_grants.assessment: Excess table grants exist, but current RLS policies provide anon only SELECT. Insert/update/delete have no anon policy and are denied by RLS under the captured policy set.
SELECT grant exists, but the only captured SELECT policy is for authenticated. No anon row access is granted by the captured policy set.
No anon base-table privilege; authenticated-only policy.
No anon base-table privilege; authenticated-only policy.

anon_view_grants.assessment: Excess grants on the view. security_invoker=true means underlying privileges still apply; base tables grant anon SELECT only, so the view grants do not provide base-table write privileges.
Excess grants on the view. security_invoker=true and no anon base-table privileges mean the view does not provide anon access to its underlying Toman tables.

findings.summary: Two SECURITY DEFINER RPCs are executable by anon; their current return schemas and bodies are limited to market/exchange-discovery metadata.
anon has broad DML/TRUNCATE grants on coin_reviews, but RLS policies captured for anon permit SELECT only. Revoke unnecessary grants after impact review and approval.
anon has SELECT on conditional_orders without an anon SELECT policy. The captured policy set therefore blocks anon row visibility; remove unnecessary grant after impact review and approval.
anon has broad privileges on two security-invoker views. Underlying grants currently constrain effective access; reduce view grants to required SELECT only after dependency and client-usage review.

limitations: This is a timestamped read-only snapshot, not a live guarantee after capture time.
has_table_privilege and role_table_grants report privileges, not proof that every operation succeeds; RLS, view updatability, security_invoker and underlying privileges also apply.
No anonymous API request was executed. Effective row visibility is inferred from the captured grants and pg_policies catalog.
